entries.rule: Before broad implementation, pin the approved representative visual artifact and approval evidence so later work cannot silently replace the design authority.
A multi-panel desktop task surface must not default to a long stacked mobile page when the mobile task is sequential; use explicit view/navigation transitions while preserving task order.
When one business option is a semantic tuple, present/select the tuple as one whole interactive row rather than independent cells that can imply invalid combinations.
Admin-specific search behavior remains a product-local profile decision and is not promoted as a universal Design Hub rule.
